# Setup

```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)
required_packages <- c("tidyverse", "rpart", "randomForest", "glmnet", "xgboost")
missing_packages <- required_packages[
  !vapply(required_packages, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)
]
if (length(missing_packages) > 0) {
  stop("Install these packages first: ", paste(missing_packages, collapse = ", "))
}
library(tidyverse)
library(rpart)
library(randomForest)
library(glmnet)
library(xgboost)
set.seed(415)
pre_color <- "#377EB8"
post_color <- "#E69F00"
phq_color <- pre_color
gad_color <- post_color
outcome_colors <- c("PHQ" = phq_color, "GAD" = gad_color)
period_colors <- c("2017-2018" = pre_color, "2022-2023" = post_color)
feature_colors <- c("Full features" = pre_color,
                    "Student characteristics only" = post_color)
paper_theme <- ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = ggplot2::element_blank()
  )
ggplot2::theme_set(paper_theme)

```

# Load Training, Testing, and Validation Data

```{r load_model_data}
project_root <- if (file.exists("data/split/training_data.csv")) {
  "."
} else if (file.exists("../data/split/training_data.csv")) {
  ".."
} else {
  stop("Cannot find data/split/training_data.csv. Open the project .Rproj first.")
}

split_dir <- file.path(project_root, "data", "split")
required_files <- c("training_data.csv", "test_data.csv", "validation_data.csv")
for (filename in required_files) {
  if (!file.exists(file.path(split_dir, filename))) {
    stop("Missing required data file: ", file.path(split_dir, filename))
  }
}
training_data <- read.csv(file.path(split_dir, "training_data.csv"))
testing_data <- read.csv(file.path(split_dir, "test_data.csv"))
validation_data <- read.csv(file.path(split_dir, "validation_data.csv"))

model_columns <- c("PHQ", "GAD", "gender", "field", "race.2",
                   "yr_sch.2", "fincur.2", "age")
for (dataset_name in c("training_data", "testing_data", "validation_data")) {
  missing_columns <- setdiff(model_columns, names(get(dataset_name)))
  if (length(missing_columns) > 0) {
    stop(dataset_name, " is missing: ", paste(missing_columns, collapse = ", "))
  }
}

dim(training_data)
dim(testing_data)
dim(validation_data)
```

# Prepare Predictive Modeling Data

```{r model_01_prepare_predictive_modeling_data}
train <- training_data %>%
  select(
    PHQ,
    GAD,
    gender,
    field,
    race.2,
    yr_sch.2,
    fincur.2,
    age
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

test <- testing_data %>%
  select(
    PHQ,
    GAD,
    gender,
    field,
    race.2,
    yr_sch.2,
    fincur.2,
    age
  ) %>%
  drop_na()

validation <- validation_data %>%
  select(
    PHQ,
    GAD,
    gender,
    field,
    race.2,
    yr_sch.2,
    fincur.2,
    age
  ) %>%
  drop_na()
```

# Set Factor Levels

```{r normalize_stem_labels}
for (dataset_name in c("train", "test", "validation")) {
  dataset <- get(dataset_name)
  dataset$field <- as.character(dataset$field)
  dataset$field[dataset$field == "NotSTEM"] <- "Non-STEM"
  assign(dataset_name, dataset)
}
```


```{r model_02_set_factor_levels}
race_levels <- c("White", "Asian", "Black", "Hispanic", "Middle Eastern")
year_levels <- c("firstyear", "secondyear", "thirdyear", "fourthyear+")

train$gender <- factor(
  train$gender,
  levels = c("Men", "Women")
)

test$gender <- factor(
  test$gender,
  levels = c("Men", "Women")
)

validation$gender <- factor(
  validation$gender,
  levels = c("Men", "Women")
)

train$field <- factor(
  train$field,
  levels = c("Non-STEM", "STEM")
)

test$field <- factor(
  test$field,
  levels = c("Non-STEM", "STEM")
)

validation$field <- factor(
  validation$field,
  levels = c("Non-STEM", "STEM")
)

train$race.2 <- factor(
  train$race.2,
  levels = race_levels
)

test$race.2 <- factor(
  test$race.2,
  levels = race_levels
)

validation$race.2 <- factor(
  validation$race.2,
  levels = race_levels
)

train$yr_sch.2 <- factor(
  train$yr_sch.2,
  levels = year_levels
)

test$yr_sch.2 <- factor(
  test$yr_sch.2,
  levels = year_levels
)

validation$yr_sch.2 <- factor(
  validation$yr_sch.2,
  levels = year_levels
)
```

# Check Dataset Sizes

```{r model_03_check_dataset_sizes}
dim(train)
dim(test)
dim(validation)
```


# Depression Prediction Models

## Depression Baseline Model

```{r model_04_depression_baseline_model}
phq_baseline_value <- mean(
  train$PHQ
)

phq_baseline_pred <- rep(
  phq_baseline_value,
  nrow(test)
)

phq_baseline_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (test$PHQ - phq_baseline_pred)^2
  )
)

phq_baseline_mae <- mean(
  abs(
    test$PHQ - phq_baseline_pred
  )
)

phq_baseline_r2 <- 0
```


## Depression Linear Regression

```{r model_05_depression_linear_regression}
phq_lm <- lm(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = train
)

summary(phq_lm)

phq_lm_pred <- predict(
  phq_lm,
  newdata = test
)

phq_lm_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (test$PHQ - phq_lm_pred)^2
  )
)

phq_lm_mae <- mean(
  abs(
    test$PHQ - phq_lm_pred
  )
)

phq_lm_r2 <- cor(
  test$PHQ,
  phq_lm_pred
)^2
```


## Depression Gender x STEM Regression

```{r model_06_depression_gender_x_stem_regression}
phq_interaction <- lm(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender * field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = train
)

summary(phq_interaction)

phq_interaction_pred <- predict(
  phq_interaction,
  newdata = test
)

phq_interaction_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (test$PHQ - phq_interaction_pred)^2
  )
)

phq_interaction_mae <- mean(
  abs(
    test$PHQ - phq_interaction_pred
  )
)

phq_interaction_r2 <- cor(
  test$PHQ,
  phq_interaction_pred
)^2
```


## Depression Regression Tree

```{r model_07_depression_regression_tree}
phq_tree <- rpart(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = train,
  method = "anova"
)

phq_tree_pred <- predict(
  phq_tree,
  newdata = test
)

phq_tree_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (test$PHQ - phq_tree_pred)^2
  )
)

phq_tree_mae <- mean(
  abs(
    test$PHQ - phq_tree_pred
  )
)

phq_tree_r2 <- cor(
  test$PHQ,
  phq_tree_pred
)^2
```

## Prepare Depression Data for Ridge and LASSO

```{r model_09_prepare_depression_data_for_ridge_and_lass}
phq_x_train <- model.matrix(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = train
)[, -1]

phq_x_test <- model.matrix(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = test
)[, -1]

phq_x_validation <- model.matrix(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = validation
)[, -1]
```

## Depression Ridge Regression

```{r model_10_depression_ridge_regression}
set.seed(415)

phq_ridge <- cv.glmnet(
  x = phq_x_train,
  y = train$PHQ,
  alpha = 0
)

phq_ridge_pred <- predict(
  phq_ridge,
  newx = phq_x_test,
  s = "lambda.min"
)

phq_ridge_pred <- as.numeric(
  phq_ridge_pred
)

phq_ridge_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (test$PHQ - phq_ridge_pred)^2
  )
)

phq_ridge_mae <- mean(
  abs(
    test$PHQ - phq_ridge_pred
  )
)

phq_ridge_r2 <- cor(
  test$PHQ,
  phq_ridge_pred
)^2
```

## Depression XGBoost

```{r model_12_depression_xgboost}
phq_xgb_train <- model.matrix(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = train
)[, -1]

phq_xgb_test <- model.matrix(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = test
)[, -1]

phq_xgb_validation <- model.matrix(
  PHQ ~ GAD +
    gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = validation
)[, -1]

set.seed(415)

phq_xgb <- xgboost(
  x = phq_xgb_train,
  y = train$PHQ,

)

  phq_xgb,

)

)
```

# Depression Test-Set Comparison

```{r model_13_depression_test_set_comparison}
depression_results <- data.frame(

  Model = c(
    "Baseline",
    "Linear Regression",
    "Gender x STEM Regression",
    "Regression Tree",
    "Random Forest",
    "Ridge Regression",
    "LASSO Regression",
    "XGBoost"
  ),

  RMSE = c(
    phq_baseline_rmse,
    phq_lm_rmse,
    phq_interaction_rmse,
    phq_tree_rmse,
    phq_rf_rmse,
    phq_ridge_rmse,
    phq_lasso_rmse,
    phq_xgb_rmse
  ),

  MAE = c(
    phq_baseline_mae,
    phq_lm_mae,
    phq_interaction_mae,
    phq_tree_mae,
    phq_rf_mae,
    phq_ridge_mae,
    phq_lasso_mae,
    phq_xgb_mae
  ),

  R2 = c(
    phq_baseline_r2,
    phq_lm_r2,
    phq_interaction_r2,
    phq_tree_r2,
    phq_rf_r2,
    phq_ridge_r2,
    phq_lasso_r2,
    phq_xgb_r2
  )
)

depression_results <- depression_results[
  order(depression_results$RMSE),
]

depression_results
```


```{r model_14_depression_test_set_comparison}
ggplot(
  depression_results,
  aes(
    x = reorder(Model, RMSE),
    y = RMSE
  )
) +
  geom_col(fill = phq_color) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Baseline" = "Baseline (mean)", "Linear Regression" = "Linear regression", "Gender x STEM Regression" = "Gender × STEM regression", "Regression Tree" = "Regression tree", "Random Forest" = "Random forest", "Ridge Regression" = "Ridge regression", "LASSO Regression" = "LASSO regression", "XGBoost" = "XGBoost")) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Depression Models",
    x = NULL,
    y = "RMSE"
  )
```

# Student Characteristics Only


## Depression Using Student Characteristics Only

```{r model_26_depression_using_student_characteristics_o}
phq_student <- lm(
  PHQ ~ gender +
    field +
    race.2 +
    yr_sch.2 +
    fincur.2 +
    age,
  data = train
)

summary(phq_student)

phq_student_pred <- predict(
  phq_student,
  newdata = test
)

phq_student_rmse <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (test$PHQ - phq_student_pred)^2
  )
)

phq_student_mae <- mean(
  abs(
    test$PHQ - phq_student_pred
  )
)

phq_student_r2 <- cor(
  test$PHQ,
  phq_student_pred
)^2
```

# Paper Figures and Tables


```{r final_paper_export_setup}
final_paper_dir <- file.path(project_root, "outputs", "final_paper")
figure_dir <- file.path(final_paper_dir, "figures")
table_dir <- file.path(final_paper_dir, "tables")
dir.create(figure_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
dir.create(table_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

save_paper_figure <- function(plot, filename, width = 8, height = 5) {
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, paste0(filename, ".png")),
                  plot = plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
  ggplot2::ggsave(file.path(figure_dir, paste0(filename, ".pdf")),
                  plot = plot, width = width, height = height, bg = "white")
}
save_paper_table <- function(tab, filename, digits = 4) {
  utils::write.csv(tab, file.path(table_dir, paste0(filename, ".csv")), row.names = FALSE, na = "")
  html <- knitr::kable(tab, format = "html", digits = digits, escape = TRUE)
  writeLines(as.character(html), file.path(table_dir, paste0(filename, ".html")), useBytes = TRUE)
}
```

## Accuracy


```{r final_paper_accuracy_helpers}
within_half_point <- function(observed, predicted) {
  observed <- as.numeric(observed)
  predicted <- as.numeric(predicted)
  keep <- is.finite(observed) & is.finite(predicted)
  if (!any(keep)) return(NA_real_)
  100 * mean(abs(observed[keep] - predicted[keep]) <= 0.5)
}

classify_symptoms <- function(scores, outcome) {
  n_items <- switch(outcome, PHQ = 9, GAD = 7,
                    stop("Expected outcome 'PHQ' or 'GAD'."))
  total <- (as.numeric(scores) - 1) * n_items
  factor(ifelse(total >= 10, "10 or higher", "Below 10"),
         levels = c("Below 10", "10 or higher"))
}

classification_metrics <- function(observed, predicted, outcome) {
  keep <- is.finite(as.numeric(observed)) & is.finite(as.numeric(predicted))
  actual <- classify_symptoms(observed[keep], outcome)
  estimated <- classify_symptoms(predicted[keep], outcome)
  tn <- sum(actual == "Below 10" & estimated == "Below 10")
  fp <- sum(actual == "Below 10" & estimated == "10 or higher")
  fn <- sum(actual == "10 or higher" & estimated == "Below 10")
  tp <- sum(actual == "10 or higher" & estimated == "10 or higher")
  safe_ratio <- function(a, b) if (b > 0) a / b else NA_real_
  precision <- safe_ratio(tp, tp + fp)
  recall <- safe_ratio(tp, tp + fn)
  specificity <- safe_ratio(tn, tn + fp)
  f1 <- safe_ratio(2 * tp, 2 * tp + fp + fn)
  data.frame(
    N = tn + fp + fn + tp,
    Within_0_5_Pct = within_half_point(observed, predicted),
    Binary_Accuracy_Pct = 100 * safe_ratio(tp + tn, tn + fp + fn + tp),
    Balanced_Accuracy_Pct = 100 * mean(c(recall, specificity)),
    Precision_Pct = 100 * precision,
    Recall_Pct = 100 * recall,
    Specificity_Pct = 100 * specificity,
    F1_Pct = 100 * f1,
    Actual_Elevated_Pct = 100 * safe_ratio(tp + fn, tn + fp + fn + tp),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

score_model_set <- function(observed, predictions, outcome, partition) {
  dplyr::bind_rows(lapply(names(predictions), function(model_name) {
    cbind(data.frame(Partition = partition, Outcome = outcome,
                     Model = model_name, stringsAsFactors = FALSE),
          classification_metrics(observed, predictions[[model_name]], outcome))
  }))
}
```

### Validation Accuracy

```{r final_paper_validation_accuracy}
phq_validation_predictions <- list(
  "Linear Regression" = phq_lm_validation_pred,
  "Gender x STEM Regression" = phq_interaction_validation_pred,
  "LASSO Regression" = phq_lasso_validation_pred,
  "XGBoost" = phq_xgb_validation_pred
)
gad_validation_predictions <- list(
  "Linear Regression" = gad_lm_validation_pred,
  "Gender x STEM Regression" = gad_interaction_validation_pred,
  "LASSO Regression" = gad_lasso_validation_pred,
  "XGBoost" = gad_xgb_validation_pred
)
validation_accuracy <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  score_model_set(validation$PHQ, phq_validation_predictions,
                  "PHQ", "Validation"),
  score_model_set(validation$GAD, gad_validation_predictions,
                  "GAD", "Validation")
)
all_validation_metrics_with_accuracy <- dplyr::left_join(
  all_validation_metrics, validation_accuracy,
  by = c("Outcome", "Model")
)
validation_results_table <- all_validation_metrics_with_accuracy %>%
  dplyr::transmute(
    Outcome = dplyr::recode(Outcome, PHQ = "Depression", GAD = "Anxiety"),
    Model = dplyr::recode(Model, "Gender x STEM Regression" = "Gender × STEM Regression"),
    RMSE = round(RMSE, 4),
    MAE = round(MAE, 4),
    `R²` = round(R2, 4),
    `Accuracy (%)` = round(Within_0_5_Pct, 1)
  )
save_paper_table(validation_results_table, "table_06_validation_model_metrics")
save_paper_table(validation_results_table, "table_08_validation_models_with_accuracy")
knitr::kable(validation_results_table, caption = "Validation Results")
```

### Confusion Matrices


```{r final_paper_best_model_confusion_matrices, fig.width=9, fig.height=4.5}
phq_best_name <- as.character(depression_validation$Model[which.min(depression_validation$RMSE)])
gad_best_name <- as.character(anxiety_validation$Model[which.min(anxiety_validation$RMSE)])

best_validation_predictions <- list(
  PHQ = phq_validation_predictions[[phq_best_name]],
  GAD = gad_validation_predictions[[gad_best_name]]
)

make_confusion_counts <- function(observed, predicted, outcome, model_name) {
  actual <- classify_symptoms(observed, outcome)
  estimated <- classify_symptoms(predicted, outcome)
  count_matrix <- table(Actual = actual, Predicted = estimated)
  out <- as.data.frame(count_matrix, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  out$Outcome <- outcome
  out$Model <- model_name
  out
}

best_confusions <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  make_confusion_counts(validation$PHQ, best_validation_predictions$PHQ,
                        "PHQ", phq_best_name),
  make_confusion_counts(validation$GAD, best_validation_predictions$GAD,
                        "GAD", gad_best_name)
) %>%
  dplyr::select(Outcome, Model, Actual, Predicted, Freq)

save_paper_table(best_confusions, "table_09_best_validation_confusion_counts")
knitr::kable(best_confusions, caption = "Confusion Matrices")

best_accuracy_summary <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  cbind(data.frame(Outcome = "PHQ", Model = phq_best_name),
        classification_metrics(validation$PHQ, best_validation_predictions$PHQ, "PHQ")),
  cbind(data.frame(Outcome = "GAD", Model = gad_best_name),
        classification_metrics(validation$GAD, best_validation_predictions$GAD, "GAD"))
)
best_models_table <- validation_results_table %>%
  dplyr::filter((Outcome == "Depression" & Model ==
    dplyr::recode(phq_best_name, "Gender x STEM Regression" = "Gender × STEM Regression")) |
    (Outcome == "Anxiety" & Model ==
    dplyr::recode(gad_best_name, "Gender x STEM Regression" = "Gender × STEM Regression")))
save_paper_table(best_models_table, "table_10_best_validation_classification_metrics")
save_paper_table(best_models_table, "table_11_accuracy_publication_ready")
knitr::kable(best_models_table, caption = "Best Models")

figure_07 <- ggplot2::ggplot(best_confusions,
  ggplot2::aes(x = Predicted, y = Actual, fill = Freq)) +
  ggplot2::geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 1) +
  ggplot2::geom_text(ggplot2::aes(label = scales::comma(Freq)),
                     size = 4, color = "black") +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = pre_color,
                               name = "Students") +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~Outcome, labeller = ggplot2::as_labeller(c(PHQ = "Depression (PHQ-9)", GAD = "Anxiety (GAD-7)")), nrow = 1) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Confusion Matrices",
    x = "Predicted symptom category", y = "Observed symptom category"
  )
print(figure_07)
save_paper_figure(figure_07, "figure_07_best_validation_confusion_matrices", 10, 4.8)
```
